name: Sea Limited
summary:
Sea Limited (SE) reported earnings of $0.93 per share on revenue of $7.10 billion for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.96 per share on revenue of $6.95 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.98 per share. The company missed expectations by 5.10% while revenue grew 46.61% on a year-over-year basis.

Sea Limited is a leading global consumer internet company founded in Singapore in 2009.
subject: Sea Limited Missed Expectations
